behaviour: Each timer pass that runs the ledger probe times one ledger read and one ledger write and stores the sample in the swarm's ledger slow state; in a parallel pass the ledger watchdog and then the ledger probe run in the before group, after the pass state is built and before any step of the pass graph starts, so the probe's write timing never includes time spent waiting for other pass steps on the same interpreter.
seam: scripts.swarm.cli.run_tick running engine.run_group for the before group with the pass state, and the ledger watchdog and ledger probe steps of scripts.tick.steps.host declared in that group on the critical lane, the probe needing the watchdog
